Job Title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
Experience: 1+ years
Location: Hybrid: Mumbai, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Recruitment
- Talent Acquisition
- LinkedIn Recruiter
- Workday
Good to have:
- Payroll
- HRIS
- Onboarding

Responsibilities:
- Act as the primary recruiter for assigned business units, managing full-cycle Recruitment from requisition intake through offer acceptance.
- Source and engage candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter and other channels; build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
- Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, create job descriptions, screen applications, conduct interviews, and provide hiring recommendations.
- Manage candidate experience end-to-end, coordinating interview schedules, providing timely feedback, and ensuring a smooth offer and acceptance process.
- Use Workday to create and manage job requisitions, track candidate progress, update interview feedback, and maintain accurate recruitment metrics and reports.
- Support onboarding coordination and handoffs to HR Operations; assist with background checks, documentation, and new joiner orientation logistics.
- Collaborate with HRBPs to align hiring strategies with business priorities and workforce planning.
- Contribute to employer branding initiatives and campus/early-career hiring events as needed.
- Continuously improve sourcing strategies, reduce time-to-fill, and track recruitment KPIs to drive hiring efficiency.
- Provide ad-hoc HR support related to Payroll, HRIS, and onboarding processes when required.
